sara-sales: Heads-up — Acme PoC needs final MSA/DPA redlines resolved before we can get PO. Legal asked for signer mapping; customer wants Net45 and a KMS addendum. Anyone free to advise routing? @ben-legal
ben-legal: On it. Can you drop the redline diff? If it's just Net45 + KMS we can sign under the standard MSA with an addendum. Need counterparty signing authority and billing contact.
sara-sales: Sent redline to drive: https://drive.redwood/acme/redline_v2 — contact is Claire (claire@acme.com), she can sign on behalf of Acme. Also POC pricing question: they want to lock committed capacity at a floor rate. How do we model that?
alex-ps: For POC pricing we usually offer a dev discount (50%) and month-to-month for trial infra. If they want a floor guarantee, propose a 3-month minimum at the discounted rate or a short commitment letter. Keep it non-binding for now.
jules-ops: If we accept Net45 on invoices, finance needs a signed orderform + billing contact set in Zuora. Who's owning signature routing? DocuSign or internal portal?
sara-sales: @jules-ops — Claire prefers DocuSign. I'll draft the orderform. OrderForm snippet: ```OrderFormID: OF-2392
Customer: Acme Corp
Total: $12,000
Term: 3mo
Payment: Net45
Billing contact: billing@acme.com```
ben-legal: Two legal notes: (1) Add a KMS appendix that references the customer's key provider (AWS KMS) and the HSM attestations; (2) Keep indemnity/limitation language tighter — I'll propose a small change to 12.3 to protect Redwood. I'll push a redline. @sara-sales attach the SFDC opp id.
sara-sales: SFDC opp: 006789-Acme-POC. Uploaded the redline with inline comments. Claire also asked about SOC2 attestation and where to find our security questionnaire answers.
mike-se: We completed their security questionnaire last week. Link: https://internal.redwood/sec/acme/secquiz_answers.pdf. SOC2 Type II is current and posted in Deploy Center. I'll DM Claire the artifacts and call out the KMS appendix notes.
deploy-bot: Deploy check: no infra changes required for hosted POC. Private deployment option requires a cleared IP addendum and ops signoff.
sara-sales: Thanks everyone. Next steps: @ben-legal to push final MSA redline by EOW; @jules-ops to prep DocuSign envelope + billing setup; @mike-se to send security artifacts to Claire. I'll coordinate signature flow and confirm signer mapping. Claire will sign once redlines accepted. :thumbsup: 
ben-legal: EOW works. If Acme tries to add unusual subprocessor obligations escalate to legal-privacy (cc: legal-privacy).
jules-ops: I'll create the DocuSign envelope and set signer roles: Acme-signatory (Claire) + Redwood-sales (sara-sales) + Redwood-finance (jules-ops). Will share link here when ready.
sara-sales: Perfect — ping me the link and I'll route. If POC pricing moves, we keep to sales-approved tiers and update the orderform.
jules-ops: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.net/env/abc123 — roles configured, routing order set. I'll attach the OF PDF in SFDC and kick the billing onboarding once signed.
